coaching_notes: I learned to be patient. I wait, and that's what's been working for me.
I don't really have problems holding trades, even for a couple of hours like this.
if you anchor the VWAP to a different candle instead, the VWAP wouldn't really change too much, so you won't mess this setup up if you choose a different candle
low liquidity/low volatility sessions (e.g. Asian session) produce slower, less swift reactions
element_inventory: PRECONDITION: identify a rotation with heavy traded volume via volume profile (institutional accumulation zone)
PRECONDITION: the heavy-volume rotation must be followed by a strong trend/sell-off (no trend follow-through = not a setup)
Anchor VWAP to the last candle of the rotation, which is the first candle of the sell-off/trend
Entry trigger: after price moves away from the anchored VWAP, enter on a pullback to the anchored VWAP
Short sub-mechanic: when price is below the VWAP (VWAP acts as resistance), short the pullback to VWAP
Long sub-mechanic: when the VWAP flips from resistance to support (price above it), long the pullback to VWAP
Occurrence selection: each successive test/pullback to the anchored VWAP is a separate valid entry (e.g. second test = another short)
Skip filter: do not trade during rotation ('when the market is rotating, VWAP setups don't work')
strategies.entry_summary: Use volume profile to locate a rotation where heavy volume was traded (institutional accumulation), confirmed by a strong trend/sell-off immediately following it. Anchor VWAP to the last candle of that rotation (the first candle of the trend/sell-off). Wait for price to move away from the anchored VWAP, then enter on a pullback back to the VWAP (the 'fair price'): short when price sits below the VWAP and it acts as resistance; long when the VWAP flips to support (price above it). Each successive test of the VWAP is a valid entry.
strategies.exit_summary: No concrete exit taught. The speaker only notes he holds trades patiently, sometimes for hours ('I learned to be patient. I wait'). No stop or profit target is given.
strategies.name: anchored_vwap_pullback_from_volume_profile_zone
